component: Multimessage row-header and shared separator CSS

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The shared multimessage stylesheet imports colors.css and sets h2.item-header rows to 1.1rem. The actual thread template uses that class. Shared toolbar and panel separator aliases both point to color-surface-border, whose accepted definition selects light/dark surface tokens. These are exact stylesheet/consumer facts; rendered sizing, theme behavior and contrast were not tested.
title: Multimessage row headers import colors and use an explicit font size
